description: This file contains C code implementing cache manipulation routines, specifically for flushing instruction and data caches on Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX based boards during kernel loading. It includes licensing information, external references to header files for cache operations and configuration, and defines a cache operation macro and a function to flush cache over a specified memory range.

methods.name: void flush_cache(unsigned long start_addr,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Function to flush cache lines over a specified memory range, aligning addresses and performing cache invalidate and writeback operations using inline assembly macros.

ctags.pattern: /^void flush_cache(unsigned long start_addr, unsigned long size)$/
